title: If It Wasn't For Satoshi
theme: Pizza Day 2024 · Satoshi / degen field / cultural moments
description: Lead of the 2024 back-to-back Pizza Day drop (with Going Cashless) paying homage to Laszlo’s original two-pizza order. Reflects cultural moments — including the Ledger orange-hat “I got your hat you little chump” schoolyard jab — and the hook’s stern point: without Satoshi creating Bitcoin, the degen crypto crowd would have no field for pump-and-dumps, scams, and debauchery (FTX collapse era still in the rear-view).
